functions.name: evaluate_release_candidate
functions.title: Evaluate release candidate
functions.description: Apply the signed-in user's active expert-verified regression tests to a system release. Use from CI after supplying one result for every active test.

agentName.description: System or agent display name; required when candidateId is omitted.

version.description: Immutable release version; required when candidateId is omitted.

results.description: One result for every active regression test.
